newsitem.title: INDONESIA: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Nov 12.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Indonesian newspapers - Nov 12.

text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Indonesian press on November 12. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
President Suharto will meet King Hussein in the Jordan capital on Tuesday on a trip expected to strengthen economic cooperation between the two nations.

Ousted leader of the Indonesian Democratic Party (PDI) Megawati Sukarnoputri told a court on Monday that she knew of the planned takeover of her headquarters, which sparked riots in Jakarta in July, two days prior to the event.

Nobel Prize winner Bishop Belo arrived in the Indonesian capital Jakarta on Monday, on the eve of the anniversary of the 1991 Santa Cruz massacre in the East Timor capital of Dili. Belo, who is in Jakarta to attend the Indonesian Bishops Conference, is due to appear in front of a parliamentary commission on Tuesday to explain a recent interview with a German magazine in which he reportedly said Indonesia treated East Timorese like dogs.

Indonesia is to introduce an endorsable ticket system between six domestic flight airlines from January 1. The airlines involved are Sempati Air, Merpati Nusantara Airlines, Garuda Indonesia, Mandala Air, Bouraq and Dirgantara Air Services.
